title: JSON Patch Operation
description: JSON Patch operation which contains the generated section with content and the JSON Pointers to apply it.

type.title: Data Type
type.description: The underlying data type of the generated text. For example, lightning__richTextType, lightning__textType.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: The operation is “add” if the value is new, or “replace” if an existing value is being updated.

parentPath.title: Parent Path
parentPath.description: The id of the component that is the parent component of the currently selected component.

precedingSiblingPath.title: Preceding Sibling Path
precedingSiblingPath.description: The id of the component that is to the immediate left of the currently selected component.

blockValue.title: Section with Content Value
blockValue.description: The JSON structure for the most recently generated section or section with content.

textValues.title: Text Values
textValues.description: The list of component ids including the generated text in all the components in the most recently generated section.

statusMessage.title: Status Message
statusMessage.description: Confirmation message from Einstein to the user to communicate that the generated changes were applied successfully or failed to be applied.

replaceSectionId.title: Replace Section Id
replaceSectionId.description: The id of an existing section that will be replaced with a newly generated section.

currentUserInput.title: Current User Input
currentUserInput.description: The complete original input received from the user.
